studyList.loadError: We couldn't load your studies. Please refresh.
studyList.title: Your studies
studyList.subtitle: A Study is one research effort. It can be a survey, an interview round, or both — the instrument mix is shown on each card. Quanti, quali, hybrid: one home for all of it.
studyList.emptyText: No studies yet. Start one — survey, interviews, or both. A Study forms around your first instrument and shows up here.

newStudyModal.title: What do you want to learn?
newStudyModal.sub: Name your study, then pick how to start. You can always add the other instrument later — the choice just decides what you build first.
newStudyModal.hint: Enter a name to choose an angle.

angles.surveyBlurb: Start broad. Collect structured responses, see the patterns, size the problem.
angles.interviewBlurb: Go deep. AI-moderated voice interviews that adapt to each participant.
angles.bothTitle: Both — start broad, then go deep
angles.bothBlurb: Survey first, then interview the most interesting segments. The full mixed-methods loop.
